name: Toki Shuuichirou
source:
A detective employed in the High-Tech Investigation Division.

His sarcastic attitude and rough manner of speaking stand out, but at his core lies a strong sense of justice and ambition.

At first, he is openly hostile and guarded against Haruho.

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4822170/view/683017363938871435]Steam[/url]]
